# 20 59 Ventures Corp.

> 20 59 Ventures Corp is an Alabama-based, SDVOSB (Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business) and 100% Veteran-Owned Housing Referral Agency and corporate accommodation provider.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Corporate Housing Solutions](https://2059ventures.online/index.html#housing): Fully-furnished short-term and long-term residential housing.
- [Government & Veteran Housing](https://2059ventures.online/capabilities.html): Specialized housing referral and placement for military, veterans, and government personnel (SAM.gov Active).
- [Senior & Assisted Relocation Services](https://2059ventures.online/index.html#seniors): Transitional housing support tailored for senior citizens.

## Key Identifiers & Verification
- **Legal Entity**: 20 59 Ventures Corp.
- **Location**: 212 W Troy St, Dothan, AL 36303
- **SAM.gov UEI**: GVR2NTGR4HU3
- **CAGE Code**: 22DH9
- **Primary NAICS**: 624220 (Community Housing Services) / 541611 (Management Consulting)
- **Classifications**: 100% Veteran-Owned Small Business, SDVOSB Self-Certified
